Name: District 1
Tip: Set off in the early morning – from noon it is hot and the lanes are crowded.

Name: Nguyễn Huệ at night
Tip: Come at sunset and stay until dark – then the promenade glows.

Name: Ben Thanh Market
Place: Ben Thanh Market Ho Chi Minh City
Tip: Come in the morning when it is cooler and less crowded, and eat a noodle soup there.

Name: War Remnants Museum
Place: War Remnants Museum Ho Chi Minh City
Tip: Come early in the morning or later in the afternoon and plan a quiet break afterwards.

Name: Notre-Dame Cathedral & Central Post Office
Tip: Write a postcard at the post office – stamps are cheap, and the hall is nicer than the square outside.

Name: Reunification Palace (Independence Palace)
Place: Independence Palace Ho Chi Minh City
Tip: Get an audio guide and go to the basement bunker first.

Name: Bitexco Financial Tower & Saigon Skydeck
Tip: Come 30–45 minutes before sunset and stay until dusk.

Name: Café apartments, Nguyễn Huệ 42
Tip: Go up in the morning, then the terraces are free and the light is better.

Name: Jade Emperor Pagoda (Chùa Ngọc Hoàng)
Place: Jade Emperor Pagoda Ho Chi Minh City
Tip: Come in the morning when fewer tour groups are there, and dress appropriately.

Name: Cholon – Chinatown, Thien Hau Temple & Binh Tay Market
Place: Cholon Chinatown Ho Chi Minh City
Tip: Go in the morning and eat at a small local place – the cuisine here has Chinese roots.

Name: Vĩnh Khánh – seafood street (District 4)
Place: Vinh Khanh Street Ho Chi Minh City
Tip: Go by Grab, order several small portions and ask about the price.

Name: Cu Chi Tunnels
Tip: Bring water and mosquito repellent and plan half a day.

Name: Mekong Delta
Place: Mekong Delta day trip from Ho Chi Minh City
Tip: Ask about small groups and what is included in the price before you book.
